category.label: formatting
category.description: Emoji and bold runs used as structure.

source: avoid-ai-writing by Conor Bronsdon (MIT), Ryan Yannelli's house rules, Pangram signs-of-ai-writing
notes: A code check in ai-patterns.mjs reports three or more bold spans in one paragraph or list item; no pattern row covers it. The pack applies one scope to every pattern, so the line-initial emoji rule also runs on commit messages and flags a gitmoji prefix such as a sparkle before `feat:`. A repo on that convention puts the glyph in `allowList.patterns`, or ships its own `formatting` pack with a `scope` that leaves out `commit`.
